description: Main module for the backend API of a Tic Tac Toe game, implemented using FastAPI. It defines endpoints for health check, game creation, move submission, score management, and chat interactions, relying on database interactions and external modules.

methods.name: GameOut _serialize_game(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Converts a MongoDB game document to a GameOut model.

methods.name: Message health_check()
methods.description: Health check endpoint to verify service is running.

methods.name: GameOut create_game(payload: GameCreate, db=Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new Tic Tac Toe game with optional player names.

methods.name: GameOut get_game( game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves current state of a game by ID.

methods.name: MoveResponse make_move( payload: MoveRequest, game_id: str = Path(..., description="Game identifier."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Submits a move for a specific game, updates game state, and manages scores.

methods.name: List[PlayerScore] get_top_scores( limit: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100, description="Number of top scores to return."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Returns a list of top player scores.

methods.name: PlayerScore get_player_score( username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific player's score by username.

methods.name: PlayerScore set_player_score( payload: PlayerScoreUpdate, username: str = Path(..., description="Player username."), db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Sets or updates a player's score.

methods.name: ChatResponse chat( payload: ChatRequest, db=Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Processes a chat message and generates an AI trash talk reply.
